messages:
Anya R: quick run follow-up — another usability session flagged the compare table when the left filter rail toggles. badges shift and keyboard focus blinks out for a frame.
Matt J: which parts shift? the perf badges or the version pins?
Anya R: mainly perf badges and the column layout. visually it's a tiny jump but users called it distracting.
Jamie (prod UX): sounds like we should stabilize layout first (min-width on badge container) and then address motion. can we also make the filter button copy clearer? users confused it with the pin modal.
Lisa - PM: proposed copy: "Open filters" instead of "Show filters". clearer when modals are stacked.
Kevin - Eng: agree. I'll add CSS: `.badge { min-width: 72px; }` and make the rail expansion respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. also will ensure focus outline stays visible during transitions.
Jamie (prod UX): add aria-live feedback for pin actions — screen reader should hear "Version pinned" / "Version unpinned".
Kevin - Eng: will implement an aria-live region and a tiny JS update to write status. fallback for older browsers included.
designbot: accessibility-lint: contrast borderline on .filter-label (3.7:1). recommend darker token or bolder weight.
Anya R: ok action list: 1) reserve badge width to stop reflow, 2) respect prefers-reduced-motion and persist focus ring, 3) aria-live for pin actions, 4) change button copy to "Open filters" + tooltip with shortcut, 5) fix contrast token.
Matt J: i'll handle copy change + tooltip and push translation keys.
Kevin - Eng: i'll do a small PR bundling 1+2+3 and include VO test steps.
Jamie (prod UX): i'll add a short mock for the copy and a11y checklist, attach before/after gifs.
Lisa - PM: prioritize motion + aria-live this sprint; copy + contrast next sprint unless quick. :thumbsup:
Anya R: thanks — dropping design notes into the review doc.
